name: MACDSimpleReshetov
summary: This EA implements a simple MACD-based trading strategy credited to Reshetov. It generates buy signals when the MACD histogram crosses above zero and sell signals when it crosses below zero, opening positions in the direction of the momentum shift. The strategy is a classic momentum-following approach using the MACD indicator as its sole signal source.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了由Reshetov提出的基于MACD的简单交易策略。当MACD柱状图上穿零轴时产生买入信号，下穿零轴时产生卖出信号，沿动量转变方向开仓。这是一个经典的动量跟踪策略，仅以MACD指标作为信号来源。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于MACD指标的动量转变，利用MACD柱状图（histogram）与零轴的交叉作为交易信号。入场条件为：当MACD柱状图从负转正（上穿零轴）时开多单，从正转负（下穿零轴）时开空单。出场条件依赖于反向信号触发平仓，即在持有多单时MACD柱状图下穿零轴则平多开空，反之亦然。仓位管理方面，该策略采用固定手数交易，未根据账户资金或波动率动态调整仓位大小。资金管理较为简单，缺乏止损和止盈的显式设置，完全依赖反向信号来关闭仓位。整体而言，这是一个典型的单指标动量策略，逻辑简洁但风险控制薄弱。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on momentum shifts detected by the MACD indicator, using the crossover of the MACD histogram with the zero line as trading signals. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when the MACD histogram crosses above zero, and a sell position is opened when it crosses below zero. Exit conditions rely on opposing signals — a long position is closed (and a short opened) when the histogram crosses below zero, and vice versa. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size without dynamic adjustment based on account equity, volatility, or risk percentage. Money management is rudimentary, lacking explicit stop-loss and take-profit levels, depending entirely on signal reversal for position closure. Overall, this is a typical single-indicator momentum strategy with simple logic but weak risk controls.
pros: 策略逻辑简洁明了，易于理解和验证
MACD是经过长期验证的经典动量指标，在趋势市场中表现良好
代码结构简单，便于修改和扩展添加额外过滤条件
零轴交叉信号客观明确，无主观判断空间
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and verify
MACD is a well-established classic momentum indicator that performs well in trending markets
Clean code structure facilitates modification and extension with additional filters
Zero-line crossover signals are objective and unambiguous with no room for subjective interpretation
cons: 缺乏止损和止盈设置，在极端行情中可能遭受巨大亏损
单一指标策略在震荡市中容易频繁产生假信号导致反复亏损
固定手数未考虑账户资金比例，无法根据风险动态调整仓位
未检查是否已存在同方向持仓，可能导致重复开仓
没有新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上多次触发交易
cons_en: Lacks stop-loss and take-profit, risking significant losses during extreme market moves
Single-indicator strategy prone to frequent whipsaws and repeated losses in ranging/choppy markets
Fixed lot size ignores account equity ratio, unable to dynamically adjust position based on risk
No check for existing positions in the same direction, potentially causing duplicate entries
No new bar check mechanism, may trigger multiple trades on the same bar
improvements: 添加止损和止盈参数，并引入移动止损保护已实现利润
增加趋势过滤器（如更高周期MA方向判断），避免在震荡行情中频繁交易
加入新K线检查和持仓检查逻辑，防止重复开仓和同一K线多次交易
实现基于账户资金比例的动态仓位管理，控制每笔交易风险在可接受范围内
improvements_en: Add stop-loss and take-profit parameters with a trailing stop to protect realized profits
Introduce a trend filter (e.g., higher timeframe MA direction) to avoid frequent trading in ranging markets
Implement new bar check and position check logic to prevent duplicate entries and multiple trades per bar
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account equity ratio to control per-trade risk within acceptable limits

risk_points: 无止损设置，单笔交易亏损可能无限扩大
未检查已有持仓方向，可能重复加仓放大风险敞口
缺少新K线检查，存在同一根K线多次开仓的风险
震荡行情中MACD零轴频繁交叉会产生大量假信号导致连续亏损
risk_points_en: No stop-loss, single trade loss can expand indefinitely
No existing position check, may duplicate positions and amplify risk exposure
Missing new bar check, risk of opening multiple positions on the same bar
MACD zero-line crossovers generate frequent false signals in choppy markets leading to consecutive losses

It generates buy signals when the MACD histogram crosses above zero and sell signals when it crosses below zero, opening positions in the direction of the momentum shift. The strategy is a classic momentum-following approach using the MACD indicator as its sole signal source.
